_comment: Remembered design decisions from the 2026-07-22 complexity refactor (validation_artifacts/complexity_decision.md). Advisory notifications for future agents; a FIRING blocks nothing (references/fitness_functions.md). JSON, not a manifest block, because this CLI runs under a python without PyYAML.

fitness_functions.name: bound-stays-essential
fitness_functions.description: The state-space bound stays at the essential-behavior size (624 = 4 orders x 4 shipped x 3 retries x 13 audit). If a new essential behavior grows it, raise this value and name the behavior.

fitness_functions.name: domains-stay-behavior-width
fitness_functions.description: Domains stay sized to the distinctions guards/invariants make; no return of production-width counters (orders/shipped cap at 3, retries at 2, auditLog at 12).

fitness_functions.name: no-new-bookkeeping-state
fitness_functions.description: auditLog is the one accepted dense row (a real global cap that guards and tests read). No second god-state variable, and every variable stays invariant-visible and justified.
